annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/639 of 12 May 2020 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 as regards standard scenarios for operations executed in or beyond the visual line of sight
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/639 of 12 May 2020 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 as regards standard scenarios for operations executed in or beyond the visual line of sight
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 150/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Regulation amending the UAS operations rules (2019/947) to add standard scenarios STS-01 (VLOS) and STS-02 (BVLOS with airspace observers), with operator declarations, remote pilot theoretical and practical training, night lighting, LUC provisions, and a revised Annex for the open and specific categories.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds standard scenarios STS-01 (VLOS, controlled ground area, C5 UAS) and STS-02 (BVLOS up to 2 km, C6 UAS) supported by operator declaration.
Requires remote pilot theory certificate (75% pass mark) and practical skill accreditation from recognised entities.
Requires a green flashing light for night operations and remote identification.
Sets rules for light UAS operator certificates, including cross-border notification to the Member State of operation.
Applies from 1 July 2020, with transitional rules for national scenarios and non-compliant open category UAS.
